speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः ।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ॥
iast:
jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ |
yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ ||
english: The yogi who is satisfied with knowledge and wisdom, unshakable, with senses mastered, to whom a lump of earth, a stone and gold are the same, is called disciplined.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु ।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ॥
iast:
suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu |
sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate ||
english: One who has the same regard for well-wishers, friends and enemies, the neutral and the impartial, the hateful and relatives, the good and even the wicked, stands out.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ॥
iast:
yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ |
ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ ||
english: The yogi should constantly practise concentration, staying in a secluded place, alone, with mind and body controlled, without expectations and without possessions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
iast:
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ |
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram ||
english: In a clean place, setting up a firm seat for oneself, neither too high nor too low, covered with cloth, a deerskin and kusha grass,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये ॥
iast:
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ |
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye ||
english: sitting there on the seat, making the mind one-pointed, with the activity of mind and senses controlled, one should practise yoga to purify oneself.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः ।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥
iast:
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ |
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan ||
english: holding the body, head and neck straight and still, steady, gazing at the tip of one's nose and not looking around,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
iast:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ |
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ ||
english: calm and fearless, firm in the vow of celibacy, controlling the mind and thinking of me, one should sit disciplined, intent on me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः ।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥
iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ |
śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati ||
english: Always practising in this way, with mind controlled, the yogi reaches peace, the supreme nirvana that rests in me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न चाति स्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥
iast:
nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ |
na cāti svapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna ||
english: Yoga is not for one who eats too much, nor for one who does not eat at all; not for one who sleeps too much, Arjuna, nor for one who stays awake too long.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
iast:
yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu |
yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā ||
english: For one who is moderate in eating and recreation, measured in effort at work, and moderate in sleep and waking, yoga becomes the destroyer of sorrow.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥
iast:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate |
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā ||
english: When the well-controlled mind rests in the self alone, free of longing for any desire, one is said to be disciplined in yoga.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥
iast:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā |
yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ ||
english: "A lamp in a windless place does not flicker": that is the comparison used for the yogi of controlled mind, practising the yoga of the self.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया ।
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥
iast:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā |
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati ||
english: When the mind, restrained by the practice of yoga, comes to rest, and when, seeing the self through the self, one is content in the self,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
iast:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam |
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ ||
english: when one knows that boundless happiness, grasped by the intellect and beyond the senses, and, established there, never moves away from the truth,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
iast:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ |
yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate ||
english: having gained which one thinks no other gain greater, and established in which one is not shaken even by great sorrow,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तं विद्याद्‌दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
iast:
taṃ vidyādduḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam |
sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviṇṇacetasā ||
english: know that this release from union with sorrow is called yoga. This yoga should be practised with determination and without discouragement.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
संकल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः ।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
iast:
saṃkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ |
manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ ||
english: Giving up completely all desires born of selfish intention, and restraining the whole range of the senses on every side by the mind alone,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद्‌बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किंचिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
iast:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamedbuddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā |
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cintayet ||
english: one should gradually come to rest, with the intellect held firm by steadiness; making the mind abide in the self, one should think of nothing at all.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
iast:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram |
tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet ||
english: Wherever the restless, unsteady mind wanders off, one should rein it in from there and bring it back under the control of the self.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् ।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥
iast:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam |
upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam ||
english: Supreme happiness comes to the yogi whose mind is at peace, whose passions are stilled, who is free of impurity and has become one with Brahman.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः ।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥
iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ |
sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute ||
english: Always practising in this way, the yogi, freed from impurity, easily attains the boundless happiness of contact with Brahman.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
iast:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani |
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ ||
english: One whose self is disciplined in yoga sees the self in all beings and all beings in the self, seeing the same everywhere.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
iast:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati |
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||
english: Whoever sees me everywhere and sees everything in me, I am never lost to them, and they are never lost to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
iast:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ |
sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate ||
english: The yogi who, established in oneness, worships me as dwelling in all beings, remains in me, however they may live.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
iast:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna |
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ ||
english: One who, by comparison with oneself, sees the same in all beings, Arjuna, whether it is pleasure or pain, is considered the highest yogi.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन ।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ॥
iast:
yo'yaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana |
etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvātsthitiṃ sthirām ||
english: Krishna, this yoga of evenness you have described, I do not see how it can last, because the mind is restless.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्‌दृढम् ।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ॥
iast:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavaddṛḍham |
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram ||
english: For the mind is restless, Krishna, turbulent, strong and stubborn. I think controlling it is as hard as controlling the wind.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
iast:
asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam |
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate ||
english: Without doubt, mighty-armed one, the mind is restless and hard to control; but it can be held, son of Kunti, through practice and detachment.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥
iast:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ |
vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo'vāptumupāyataḥ ||
english: Yoga is hard to reach for one who lacks self-control; that is my view. But one who is self-controlled and keeps striving can reach it by the right means.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः ।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥
iast:
ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ |
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati ||
english: Krishna, what becomes of one who has faith but does not strive enough, whose mind strays from yoga, and who fails to reach perfection in yoga?

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥
iast:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati |
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi ||
english: Fallen from both, does such a person not perish like a scattered cloud, without support, mighty-armed one, lost on the path to Brahman?

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ॥
iast:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ |
tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate ||
english: Krishna, please dispel this doubt of mine completely; no one but you can dispel it.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्‌दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
iast:
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate |
na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaściddurgatiṃ tāta gacchati ||
english: Son of Pritha, there is no destruction for such a person, neither in this world nor in the next; for no one who does good, my friend, ever comes to a bad end.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः ।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ॥
iast:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate ||
english: Having reached the worlds of those who do good and lived there for countless years, one who fell from yoga is born into the home of the pure and prosperous.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥
iast:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām |
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam ||
english: Or they are born into a family of wise yogis; but a birth like this is harder to gain in this world.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥
iast:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam |
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana ||
english: There they regain the understanding they had in their former body, and from there they strive again for perfection, joy of the Kurus.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ॥
iast:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo'pi saḥ |
jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate ||
english: By that earlier practice they are carried forward even without wanting to; even one who merely wishes to know yoga goes beyond the Veda, Brahman in the form of words.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः ।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ |
anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
english: But the yogi who strives with effort, cleansed of wrongdoing and perfected over many births, then reaches the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः ।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ॥
iast:
tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo'pi mato'dhikaḥ |
karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna ||
english: The yogi is greater than ascetics, greater even than people of learning, and greater than people of ritual action. So be a yogi, Arjuna.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान् भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
iast:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā |
śraddhāvān bhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ ||
english: And of all yogis, the one who worships me with faith, with their inner self absorbed in me, I consider the most disciplined of all.
